Container.Name: ChannelFlow
Container.Overview: ChannelFlow-Server — simulated live TV for Jellyfin (channels, EPG, commercials, native WeatherStar, and news). Pair with the ChannelFlow plugin. Mount the same media share Jellyfin uses, then set path remaps in the Web UI. Point POSTGRES_* at PostgreSQL on the same Docker network.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL on the same Docker network as this container and Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: ChannelFlow Web UI, admin API, M3U/XMLTV, and live streams

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Config, logos, logs, caches, weather/news working files (CHANNELFLOW_CONFIG). Logs are in logs/channelflow-YYYYMMDD.log

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Same library share Jellyfin uses; remap Jellyfin prefixes to /media in Settings

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel VAAPI encode and decode

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin base URL on the shared Docker network

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname on the Docker network

Config.Name: FFmpeg path
Config.Description: Path to ffmpeg inside the container

Config.Name: FFmpeg HWAccel
Config.Description: vaapi for Intel Quick Sync, or leave empty for software

Config.Name: FFmpeg VAAPI device
Config.Description: VAAPI render node inside the container

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public origin for M3U/XMLTV when reverse-proxied, e.g. https://channelflow.example.duckdns.org

Config.Name: Path base
Config.Description: Only if the UI is under a subpath, e.g. /channelflow
